# Auxiliary functions

**Differences in fit**

`fit_diff()`, to summarize the differences between invariance levels

```{r}
fit_diff <- function(fit1, fit2) {
  lrt <- lavTestLRT(fit1, fit2)
  data.frame(D.chisq = round(lrt$`Chisq diff`[2], 2),
             D.df = lrt$`Df diff`[2],
             pvalue = signif(lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], 3),
             D.cfi = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "cfi.scaled") -
                                   fitMeasures(fit1, "cfi.scaled")), 3),
             D.rmsea = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "rmsea.scaled") -
                                     fitMeasures(fit1, "rmsea.scaled")), 3))}
```

`plot_pred()`, to create our plots more easily

```{r}
plot_pred <- function(model, term, by = NULL, type = c("auto", "line", "point"),
                      ci_level = NULL, ylim = NULL, x_back = NULL,
                      x_lab = NULL, y_lab = NULL, title = NULL) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  ci <- length(ci_level) > 0 && !is.na(ci_level)
  d <- as.data.frame(ggpredict(model, c(term, by),
                               ci_level = if (ci) ci_level else NA))
  if (!is.null(x_back)) d$x <- d$x * x_back[2] + x_back[1]   # <- new
  if (type == "auto") type <- if (is.numeric(d$x)) "line" else "point"
  dodge <- position_dodge(.4)
  ci_aes <- aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)

  ggplot(d, aes(x, predicted, group = group)) +
    (if (!is.null(by)) aes(shape = group, linetype = group)) +
    switch(type,
           line  = list(if (ci) geom_ribbon(ci_aes, alpha = .15, colour = NA),
                        geom_line(linewidth = .7)),
           point = list(if (ci) geom_errorbar(ci_aes, width = .15,
                                              position = dodge),
                        geom_point(size = 2.5, position = dodge))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, title = title, shape = by, linetype = by) +
    theme_bw()}
```

`save_grid()`, to save our plot grids

```{r}
save_grid <- function(plots, file, ncol = 2,
                      total_width = 8, panel_height = 2.75, tags = TRUE)
  {ggsave(file,
        cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots,
                            ncol = ncol, align = "hv",
                            labels = if (tags) "AUTO" else NULL),
        width  = total_width,
        height = ceiling(length(plots)/ncol) * panel_height,
        dpi = 600) }
```


# I. Data preparation

## 1. Import the data

```{r}
d0 = read_sav("TBIMS_cleaned.sav") %>%
  mutate(across(1:26 & where(haven::is.labelled), haven::as_factor),
         across(-(1:26), \(x) { attributes(x) = NULL; x }) ) %>%
  haven::zap_formats()
```

Keep sociodemographic and test variables (excluding "GADDifficult" and "GAD7TOT", as they're not raw items)

```{r}
gad0 = d0 %>%
  select(UID, Age, Race, Sex, Mar, EduYears,
         Cause, CTComp, GCSTot,
         matches("^GAD", ignore.case=FALSE),
         -matches("GADDifficult|GAD7TOT"))
```

Recode items into Not at all (0), Several days (1), More than half the days (2), Nearly every day (3), and NA (6, 9, 10 and NA)


```{r}
gad0 <- gad0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    matches("GAD"),
    ~ ordered (ifelse(.x > 3, NA, .x),
               levels = c(0,1,2,3),
               labels = c("not at all", "several days",
                          "more than half the days", "nearly every day"))))
```

## 2. Remove missing data

Create columns for missing data

```{r}
gad0 <- gad0 %>%
  mutate(
    missing_T1 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".1"), is.na)),
    missing_T2 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".2"), is.na)),
    missing_T3 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".3"), is.na)),
    missing_T4 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".4"), is.na)),
    missing_T5 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".5"), is.na)),
    missing_T6 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".6"), is.na)),
    missing_T7 = rowSums(across(contains("GAD") & ends_with(".7"), is.na)) )
```

Cross-sectional: complete data for each timepoint (divided by race)

```{r}
gad0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_2 = sum(missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_3 = sum(missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_4 = sum(missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_5 = sum(missing_T5 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_6 = sum(missing_T6 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_7 = sum(missing_T7 == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

- Available cross-sectional data:
  - White and Black patients
  - Timepoints 1, 2, 3 and 4
  - Lowest n=237

Longitudinal: complete data for each race (divided by T1, T1+2...)

```{r}
gad0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3_4 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0 & missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

- Available longitudinal data:
  -   White patients
  -   Timepoints 1 and 2
  -   Lowest n=808

**Final dataset**

```{r}
gad7 = gad0 %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin")) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("\\.[12]$")) %>%
  mutate(Race = droplevels(Race))
nrow(gad7)
```

## 3. Final prep

Create vectors with fit indices names

```{r}
names_fit = c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "cfi.scaled",
              "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled",
              "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")

names_short = c("chisq", "df", "chisq/df", "cfi", "rmsea",
                "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "srmr")
```

Remove unnecessary objects

```{r}
rm(d0, gad0)
```

## Proportions per timepoint

```{r}
proportions = gad7 %>%
  select(matches("^GAD.+\\.[12]$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("item", "timepoint"),
               names_sep = "\\.", values_to = "response") %>%
  drop_na(response) %>%
  count(item, timepoint, response, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(item, timepoint) %>%
  mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = item, names_from = c(response, timepoint),
              values_from = prop, names_sort = TRUE)
```


# II. Cross-sectional MI

## 1. One year after TBI

Create the sub-dataset

```{r}
T1_gad7 <- gad7 %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("GAD.*\\.1$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("GAD.*\\.1$"))
nrow(T1_gad7)
```

Create the model

```{r}
T1_mod = 'Anxiety =~ GADNervous.1 +
                     GADCntrlWry.1 +
                     GADWorry.1 +
                     GADRelax.1 +
                     GADRestless.1 +
                     GADAnnoy.1 +
                     GADAfraid.1'
```

**Descriptive statistics**

```{r}
T1desc = table1( ~ Sex +
          Age +
          Race +
          Mar +
          EduYears +
          Cause +
          GCSTot +
          CTComp,
        data = T1_gad7)
T1desc
```

### 1.1. Configural

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod1 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_mod,
                                data = T1_gad7,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "configural")) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod1))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit1 = cfa(T1_mod1,
              data = T1_gad7,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit1, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

### 1.2. Thresholds

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod2 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_mod,
                                data = T1_gad7,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "thresholds")) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod2))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit2 = cfa(T1_mod2,
              data = T1_gad7,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit2, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit1, T1_fit2)
```

### 1.3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_mod,
                                data = T1_gad7,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"))) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod3))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit3 = cfa(T1_mod3,
              data = T1_gad7,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit3, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit2, T1_fit3)
```

### 1.4. Intercept

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod4 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_mod,
                                data = T1_gad7,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings",
                                                "intercepts"))) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod4))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit4 = cfa(T1_mod4,
              data = T1_gad7,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit4, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit4, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit3, T1_fit4)
```


### Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
MI_T1 <- rbind(
  configural = fitmeasures(T1_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(T1_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading    = fitmeasures(T1_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit),
  intercept  = fitmeasures(T1_fit4, fit.measures = names_fit))

MI_T1 <- MI_T1 %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

MI_T1 = round(MI_T1, 3)
colnames(MI_T1) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}
diff_T1 <- rbind(
  conf_thres = fit_diff(T1_fit1, T1_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(T1_fit2, T1_fit3),
  load_inter = fit_diff(T1_fit3, T1_fit4))
```


**All results**

```{r}
T1_results = list(MI = MI_T1,
                  diff = diff_T1)

round(T1_results$MI,3)
round(T1_results$diff,4)
```

### Remove objects

```{r}
rm(T1_gad7, T1_mod)
rm(T1_mod1, T1_mod2, T1_mod3, T1_mod4,
   T1_fit1, T1_fit2, T1_fit3, T1_fit4)
rm(MI_T1, diff_T1)
```

## Export results

```{r, eval=FALSE}
    "<h2>Timepoint 1</h2>",
    as.character(T1desc),
    "<h2>Timepoint 2</h2>",
    as.character(T2desc)),
  "data/descriptivesCross.html")
```

Proportions

```{r, eval=FALSE}
write_xlsx(proportions, "data/proportiontables.xlsx")
```

Fit indices

```{r, eval=FALSE}
toexcel <- \(x) data.frame(model = rownames(x), x, check.names = FALSE)

write_xlsx(list(
  T1_MI   = toexcel(T1_results$MI),
  T1_diff = toexcel(T1_results$diff),
  T2_MI   = toexcel(T2_results$MI),
  T2_diff = toexcel(T2_results$diff)),
  "data/CrossMI_results.xlsx")
```

# III. Longitudinal MI

Create the model

```{r}
long_mod = 'T1.Anxiety =~ GADNervous.1 +
                          GADCntrlWry.1 +
                          GADWorry.1 +
                          GADRelax.1 +
                          GADRestless.1 +
                          GADAnnoy.1 +
                          GADAfraid.1
            
            T2.Anxiety =~ GADNervous.2 +
                          GADCntrlWry.2 +
                          GADWorry.2 +
                          GADRelax.2 +
                          GADRestless.2 +
                          GADAnnoy.2 +
                          GADAfraid.2'
```

Create factor correspondence

```{r}
long_factors = list(Anxiety = c("T1.Anxiety", "T2.Anxiety"))
```

Select complete data

```{r}
full_gad7 <- gad7 %>%
  filter(if_all(matches("GAD.*\\.(1|2)$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("GAD.*\\.(1|2)$"))
nrow(full_gad7)
```
**Descriptive statistics**

```{r}
fulldesc = table1( ~ Sex +
          Age +
          Race +
          Mar +
          EduYears +
          Cause +
          GCSTot +
          CTComp,
        data = full_gad7)

fulldesc
```


## 1. Configural

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
full_mod1 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_mod,
                                data = full_gad7,     
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
                                longFacNames = long_factors,
                                long.equal = "")) 
#cat(as.character(full_mod1))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
full_fit1 = cfa(full_mod1,
             data = full_gad7,
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
#summary(full_fit1, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(full_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

## 2. Thresholds

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
full_mod2 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_mod,
                                data = full_gad7,     
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
                                longFacNames = long_factors,
                                long.equal = "thresholds")) 
#cat(as.character(full_mod2))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
full_fit2 = cfa(full_mod2,
             data = full_gad7,
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
#summary(full_fit2, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(full_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(full_fit1, full_fit2)
```

## 3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
full_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_mod,
                                data = full_gad7,     
                                ordered = T,
```

## Factor scores

Calculate factor scores

```{r, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
idx <- lavInspect(full_fit4, "case.idx")
Anx_scores <- as.data.frame(lavPredict(full_fit4, type = "lv",
                                       method = "EBM"))[order(idx), ]
stopifnot(nrow(Anx_scores) == length(idx))
full_gad7[sort(idx), names(Anx_scores)] <- Anx_scores

saveRDS(Anx_scores, "data/Anx_scores.rds")
```

```{r}
Anx_scores <- readRDS("data/Anx_scores.rds")
```

Format the information

```{r}
Anx_combined <- full_gad7 %>%
  select(1:9) %>%
  bind_cols(Anx_scores)

Anx_combined <- Anx_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^T\\d\\.Anxiety$"),
    names_to = c("Timepoint", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "T(\\d)\\.(Anxiety)")
```

**Other fixes**

Keep only cases with complete data

```{r}
nrow(Anx_combined)

Anx_Fscores <- Anx_combined %>%
  # Remove missing data
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  # Re-order variables
  select(UID, Age, Race, Sex, Mar, EduYears,
         GCSTot, CTComp, Cause, Timepoint, Anxiety)

nrow(Anx_Fscores)
```
Check and fix sparsity

```{r}
sapply(Anx_Fscores[,3:9], summary, useNA="ifany")
```

```{r}
table(Anx_Fscores$Mar, useNA="ifany")

Anx_Fscores <- Anx_Fscores %>%
  mutate(
    Mar = case_when(
      Mar %in% c("Single (Never Married)") ~ "Single (Never Married)",
      Mar %in% c("Married") ~ "Married",
      Mar %in% c("Divorced") ~ "Divorced",
      Mar %in% c("Widowed") ~ "Widowed",
      Mar %in% c("Separated", "Cohabitation", "Other") ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA),
    Mar = factor(Mar, levels = c("Single (Never Married)", "Married",
                                 "Divorced", "Widowed", "Other")))

table(Anx_Fscores$Mar, useNA="ifany")
```
Format variables as prefered

```{r}
Anx_Fscores <- Anx_Fscores %>%
  mutate(
    Race = factor(Race, labels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic")),
    Mar = factor(Mar, labels = c("Sin", "Mar", "Div", "Wid", "Oth")),
    EduYears = factor(EduYears, labels = c("Up to 12", "12+")),
    GCSTot = factor(GCSTot, labels = c("Mild", "Moderate", "Severe")),
    CTComp = factor(CTComp, labels = c("No abn", "Visible abn")),
    Cause = factor(Cause, labels = c("RTA", "Vio", "Spo", "Fal", "Ped")),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, labels = c("T1", "T2")))
```

# IV. Sensitivity analysis

Create the model

```{r}
long_mod = 'T1.Anxiety =~ GADNervous.1 +
                          GADCntrlWry.1 +
                          GADWorry.1 +
                          GADRelax.1 +
                          GADRestless.1 +
                          GADAnnoy.1 +
                          GADAfraid.1
            
            T2.Anxiety =~ GADNervous.2 +
                          GADCntrlWry.2 +
                          GADWorry.2 +
                          GADRelax.2 +
                          GADRestless.2 +
                          GADAnnoy.2 +
                          GADAfraid.2'
```

Create factor correspondence

```{r}
long_factors = list(Anxiety = c("T1.Anxiety", "T2.Anxiety"))
```

## 1. White patients

```{r}

  filter(Race %in% c("White"),
```

# V. Score predictors

## 1. Variable selection

### 1.1. Fixed effects

```{r}
Anx_full_fit <- regsubsets(Anxiety ~ poly(Age,2) + Race + Sex + Mar + EduYears
                                   + Cause + GCSTot + CTComp + Timepoint
                                   + Race:Timepoint,
                           data = Anx_Fscores, nvmax=20)
```

Number of models checked

```{r}
Anx_full_fit$xnames

length(Anx_full_fit$xnames) - 1

sapply(Anx_Fscores[c("Race", "Sex", "Mar", "EduYears",
                   "Cause", "GCSTot", "CTComp", "Timepoint")], nlevels)

ncol(model.matrix(Anxiety ~ poly(Age,2) + Race + Sex + Mar + EduYears
                                   + Cause + GCSTot + CTComp + Timepoint
                                   + Race:Timepoint,
                           data = Anx_Fscores)) - 1
```

Select variables

```{r}
Anx_full_summary = summary(Anx_full_fit)

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(Anx_full_summary$adjr2, type = "b")
abline(v = which.max(Anx_full_summary$adjr2), col = 2)
plot(Anx_full_summary$cp, type = "b")
abline(v = which.min(Anx_full_summary$cp), col = 2)
plot(Anx_full_summary$bic, type = "b")
abline(v = which.min(Anx_full_summary$bic), col = 2)
```

-   Following the AIC/CP indicator, we choose the model with 9

```{r}
Anx_full_summary$which[9,]
```

-   Included fixed effects:
    - Age (poly)
    - Race
    - Sex
    - Mar
    - EduYears
    - GCSTot
    - Timepoint
    - Race:Timepoint

**Prepare age variable**

```{r}
Anx_Fscores <- Anx_Fscores  %>%
  mutate(Age_z = as.numeric(scale(Age)))
```

### 1.2. Random effect

```{r}
# Fixed effects model
Anx.null <- lm(Anxiety ~ Age_z + I(Age_z^2) + Race
                       + Sex + Mar + EduYears + GCSTot
                       + Timepoint + Race*Timepoint,
               data=Anx_Fscores)
# Random effects model
Anx.lmer <- lmer(Anxiety ~ Age_z + I(Age_z^2) + Race
                       + Sex + Mar + EduYears + GCSTot
                       + Timepoint + Race*Timepoint + (1|UID),
                 data=Anx_Fscores)
```

Comparison

```{r}
# LRT test
mean(1 - pchisq(-2 * (logLik(Anx.null, REML = TRUE)
                      - logLik(Anx.lmer, REML = TRUE)), df = c(0, 1)))

# AIC and BIC
merge(AIC(Anx.null, Anx.lmer), BIC(Anx.null, Anx.lmer), by = "df")

# Proportion of variance
performance::icc(Anx.lmer)
```

-   Small p-value, differences in fit indices and in ICC -\> There's significant variance between subjects -\> Thus, UID is included as a random effect

### 1.3. Final model

```{r}
Anx_fit <- lmer(Anxiety ~ Age_z + I(Age_z^2) + Race
                       + Sex + Mar + EduYears + GCSTot
                       + Timepoint + Race*Timepoint + (1|UID),
                 data=Anx_Fscores, REML = TRUE)
```

Check results

```{r}
summary(Anx_fit)$coefficients
```

Save the results

```{r}
write.xlsx(round(summary(Anx_fit)$coefficients, 3),
           "data/LMM_coefficients.xlsx", rowNames=TRUE)
```

### Remove objects

```{r}
rm(Anx_full_fit, Anx_full_summary) # Fixed effects
rm(Anx.null, Anx.lmer) # Random effect
```

## 2. Plotting

### 2.1. Predicted scores

```{r, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE}
terms <- list(Age = "Age_z [all]", Sex = "Sex",
              Mar = "Mar", EduYears = "EduYears",
              GCSTot = "GCSTot", Race_Timepoint = c("Timepoint", "Race"))

Anx_Pscores <- terms %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(\(t) ggpredict(Anx_fit, terms = t))

Anx_Pscores$Age$x <- Anx_Pscores$Age$x * sd(Anx_Fscores$Age) + mean(Anx_Fscores$Age)

saveRDS(Anx_Pscores, "data/Anx_Pscores.rds")
```

```{r}
Anx_Pscores <- readRDS("data/Anx_Pscores.rds")
```

### 2.2. Plots

Range for the Y axis

```{r}
Yrange <- Anx_Pscores %>%
  map(\(p) c(p$conf.low, p$conf.high)) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  range()
```

Individual plots

```{r, message=FALSE}
Age = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "Age_z [all]",
                ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                x_back = c(mean(Anx_Fscores$Age), sd(Anx_Fscores$Age)),
                x_lab = "Age (years)", y_lab = "Predicted mean factor score")

Sex = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "Sex",
                ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                x_lab = "Sex", y_lab="Predicted mean factor score")

Mar = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "Mar",
                ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                x_lab = "Marital status", y_lab="Predicted mean factor score")

EduYears = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "EduYears",
                ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                x_lab = "Years of education", y_lab="Predicted mean factor score")

GCSTot = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "GCSTot",
                ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                x_lab = "Injury severity", y_lab="Predicted mean factor score")

Race_Time = plot_pred(model = Anx_fit, term = "Timepoint", by = "Race",
                      ci_level = 0.95, ylim = Yrange,
                      x_lab = "Timepoint", y_lab="Predicted mean factor score")
```
